title: Drawn-Response Method Run Log Record
$comment: Not a phase-1 spec label type -- this is harness scaffolding to support docs/research/TASK-0011_PHASE_1_EXECUTION_SPEC.md section 8.3's latency, cost, and reviewer-burden metrics, which need a per-invocation log distinct from the per-criterion decision records (one method call may produce several criterion decisions for one image).

criterion_ids_produced.description: Which criterion_decision records this single invocation produced.

latency_ms.description: End-to-end latency for this invocation. Null for human labeling rows where wall-clock latency is not the relevant signal (use reviewer_minutes instead).

cost_usd.description: Provider/compute cost for this invocation. Null for human labeling rows.

reviewer_minutes.description: Human reviewer time for this invocation. Null for unattended automated method rows that were not human-reviewed.

human_reviewed.description: Whether this result passed through human review before being counted as accepted (section 8.3: 'cost per accepted result and per human-reviewed result').
